A student carries out an experiment to find the speed of sound. She uses a tube that is initially filled with water to the top. A valve at the bottom of the tube can be opened to release water.

As water is flowing out of the tube, the student blows air across the top of the tube. A maximum sound intensity is heard for the first time when the water is at level A and for the second time when the water is at level B.

Which of the following are correct expressions for the wavelength of the sound? 

I.

II. .

III. .

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
